That means the C-suite who were set to attend the workshop will now be in an all-day prep meeting the same day. I'm really sorry for the short notice — this just came up.

- Postpone to Dec 21 (same agenda) if that works for your team, or
- Run the workshop remotely on the 19th (full-day virtual) with our execs dialing in.

I know travel and vendor commitments are likely already in place. Please let me know what is feasible and any expected costs we should expect to cover. We appreciate your flexibility here.

I attached the agenda and my itinerary to reference (same files as before).

Thanks — appreciate quick thoughts.

-- Lauren

Lauren / Vivek —

Short answers from ops/CS side:
- We can pivot to a fully remote workshop on the 19th with ~24 hours of prep. I'll switch the agenda to include virtual breakouts (Miro + timed facilitator prompts) and reduce set-up time. I can run the facilitation if Lauren can't make it in person, and Vivek can cover the leadership Q&A remotely.
- Hotel: I called the Columbia River Hotel — the group block has a 48-hour no-penalty cancelllation window, but because this is within that window they're charging a one-night fee for Lauren's room. I asked for leniency given the storm and customer conflict; the hotel manager said they'd waive the fee if we submit the cancellation request by EOD tomorrow and provide a corporate letter.
- AV/vendor: local AV vendor requires 24-hour notice for full refund; otherwise 50% refund possible.

Recommendation: Offer the customer two options and include Redwood covering the non-refundable one-night hotel fee if they pick Dec 21, or cover AV facilitation costs if they pick virtual (we'll absorb up to $2,500). We should also proactively offer a condensed virtual executive-only session on Dec 19 morning (60–90 min) to keep momentum.

I'll draft a customer-facing note.

—Marissa

Elena —

Thanks for the quick heads up and totally understand — these board items are time-sensitive. On our side we've reviewed options and can do either of the following:

Option A — Move to Dec 21 (onsite):
- Same agenda and room booking available;
- Redwood will absorb the one-night non-refundable hotel charge for my room (we'll submit the corporate letter to the hotel for a waiver but will cover if necessary);
- We will confirm AV/vendor rebooking and cover any fee up to $1,000.

Option B — Run fully remote on Dec 19: 
- Full-day virtual workshop with remote breakouts; Marissa will facilitate and Vivek will join for the leadership Q&A. We'll provide a condensed executive-only 90-minute session the morning of the 19th if your execs prefer focused time.
- Redwood will cover facilitation/AV costs up to $2,500 for the remote setup.

Please let us know which option you prefer by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize travel and vendor changes. If neither works, propose a date and we'll check Redwood availability.

Apologies again for the disruption — we'll make whichever path you pick as seamless as possible.

Best,
